description: Festival suite inputs (spec section 6, F23): every slug of data/festival-rules.json for 2026, 2027 and 2028 compared with Drik Panchang's monthly festival pages (/festivals/month/festivals-<month>.html?year=<y>&geoname-id=<id>) for Delhi with the Purnimanta school and Chennai with the Amanta school (the school is Drik's `drik-school-name` cookie). 12 page loads per city-year; the fetcher stores every event the page lists (name, Gregorian date, tithi text). reference/festivals/name-map.json maps slugs to Drik event names; CONVENTIONS.md section 3 documents every accepted date difference.

notOnDrik.description: Slug-years that Drik Panchang does not publish for these cities (checked on the fetched monthly pages, 2026-10-26, Phase A review M2). check.mjs removes them from the required count so the gate measures real shortfalls; the festival suite never had anything to compare for them.
